تبتهجن (form VIII)
# تَبْتَهِجْنَ (tabtahijna) /tab.ta.hid͡ʒ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# تُبْتَهَجْنَ (tubtahajna) /tub.ta.had͡ʒ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
